blocks.title: F audit · Manual review of every live Sarvam draft (run 3, 30 Oct)

metrics.label: drafts with a real problem, by manual audit
of those, caught by the guard

blocks.note: Audited line by line in F_live_run3_manual_audit.csv. The guard catches invented numbers, dates, promises and false completions; it cannot catch a draft that mixes up which way the money goes. That is why Tatkal speaks engine templates by default and uses Sarvam 105B to READ replies, not to write facts.
